$schema_note: The 224 communities of the Emirate of Dubai. Identity is communityNumber (the official community number, whose first digit is the sector). name is verbatim from the source layer (English in upper case, as published); nameDisplay.en is title-cased for user interfaces only. centroid and bbox are derived from the source boundary polygons ([lon, lat] / [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat], WGS 84) and are approximate — they are not official coordinates. Store and match by communityNumber, never by name.
source: Dubai Municipality GIS community layer (Community_20260815), obtained from Dubai Data (data.dubai) as Open-classified data
